description: This file contains the implementation of serializers and copiers for multi-dimensional arrays in the Orleans serialization framework. It defines classes for serializing, deserializing, and deep copying multi-dimensional arrays of generic element types.

classes.name: MultiDimensionalArrayCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for multi-dimensional arrays, handling serialization and deserialization of arrays with arbitrary dimensions.

classes.name: MultiDimensionalArrayCopier<T>
classes.description: Provides deep copy functionality for multi-dimensional arrays.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a multi-dimensional array into a wire format.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from wire format into a multi-dimensional array.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a multi-dimensional array.
